events.note: The adversary (satan) is a delegation of the Jewish leaders, the generation of vipers (Matthew 3:7; 12:34). Having seen his baptism, they offer him the kingdoms of the land, the tetrarchies of Israel, if he will lead them as their king. Matthew gives the order: the wilderness of the Jordan valley, the pinnacle of the temple, a high mountain: Pisgah, where the LORD shewed Moses all the land (Deuteronomy 34:1–4), and where Balak took Balaam to view Israel, offering him honour (Numbers 22:17; 23:14).
